value.rationale: The 2023 map is explicitly proposed for adjustable statistics and algorithmic chaotic sampling. A sharp nonmixing band-exchange threshold and exactly computable persistent parity correlations reveal a structural and practical obstruction to equating positive entropy with mixing. This is a natural mathematical classification and all-lag invariant, not an arbitrary slice or small numerical gain.
